title: GWU vs RPI: tuition, size, location
summary: George Washington University (GWU) versus Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI). Also searched as RPI vs GWU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute vs George Washington University (RPI vs GWU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. RPI vs GWU differ notably in undergraduate enrollment, with RPI having 5,714 students compared to GWU's 11,182. Tuition costs for in-state students are also distinct, with RPI charging $64,081 and GWU slightly higher at $67,710. Geographically, RPI is located in Troy, while GWU is situated in Washington, highlighting their different urban settings.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance between Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute vs George Washington University (RPI vs GWU), tuition fees for both in-state and out-of-state students are identical within each institution but vary between the two. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each university.
